method: A bounded streaming decompression hashed the original output, located the fixed selected key, and parsed only its 1627-byte value. The original five arrays were independently compared to accepted definitions. No other witness entry was decoded or checked; verify.py was not executed.
theorem_correspondence: PR1942L450OriginalWitness.witness_value proves equality of the typed witness Value to the complete original five-array Value represented in the source. The external excerpt-to-source mapping is independently source-reviewed, not a Lean file parser theorem.
limits: The byte interval is an observed external extraction identity, not a verified parser span.
The compressed file, whole decoded envelope and original source dictionary are not bundled or certified as fully parsed.
Source hash equality is an identity check, not cryptographic authentication of the producer.
